title: IseFDK Circular Museum Rotunda
asset_role: Decorative 2.5D architectural foundation for a single-viewport spatial museum prototype

original_generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: photoreal architectural background for a single-viewport interactive spatial museum, desktop landscape 16:9
Primary request: Create one original architectural visualization of a spacious circular museum rotunda. This must be a clearly round central room, with a continuous curved back wall and curved concentric stone floor joints, not a rectangular hall.
Scene and style: warm white modern neoclassical museum architecture, pared-back contemporary stone, monumental but calm, museum-like rather than temple-like. Airy oval skylight overhead, natural daylight, physically convincing soft shadows. Subtle limestone texture, ivory/off-white palette, only tiny restrained brass details, very little greenery. No ornate decoration.
Composition: fixed centered frontal eye-level camera looking across the circular central hall, a complete single viewport with wide landscape 16:9 framing. Back wall bows gently around the central space. At exactly approximately x50%, y72% of the image place a low EMPTY oval stone sculpture plinth, wide smooth elliptical top, just one low step, no sculpture or object on it. The empty plinth is the central foreground focal point and will receive a separate sculpture in software.
Critical passage layout: In the CURVED back wall BEHIND the plinth, show TWO ACTUAL LARGE OPEN DOORWAYS, balanced, one centered approximately x26%, y45%, the other x74%, y45%. Both must visibly read as open passages. Large clean arches or restrained rounded openings are fine; no door panels. Each opens to a long bright neutral modern museum corridor with clearly visible perspective depth, receding floor and walls; the corridor ends are distant. Both openings must be fully visible, visually equal, and separated by generous curved wall. No central doorway. The empty plinth must not block the openings.
Space for overlay: leave clean negative space in upper corners and ample quiet left and right foreground for very small software-added labels.
Materials: matte pale limestone walls and floor, delicate fine joints, soft daylight falloff, convincing ambient occlusion. A graceful light skylight rim, no heavy classical columns. Refined high-end photoreal architectural render.
Constraints: one scene only, no montage, no interface, no text, no signage, no letters, no people, no paintings, no artwork, no sculptures. Empty plinth only. No grand staircase, no balustrades, no throne, no altar, no statues, no baroque detail, no ornate temple, no Olympus look. Must unmistakably communicate curved rotunda geometry and two navigable corridors.

composition_guidance.coordinate_system: Normalized original desktop image; top-left 0,0, bottom-right 1,1; approximate visual anchors

composition_guidance.implementation: Render the abstract sculpture and interaction labels separately. Keep architecture decorative, with HTML providing navigation semantics.
